question_text: Construct remove_item(self, item) for Shop’s fixed list self.items and occupied count self.used. Assume the exact object item occurs once among occupied entries. Remove it, preserve the relative order of other entries, clear the now-unused position to None, and decrement self.used.
adaptation_rationale: Retains reference-array compaction; tested first, middle, last removal; no Java-specific fixed array syntax.

marking_points.criterion: Locates the exact object using identity.
Shifts every subsequent occupied entry one position left.
Stops shifting at the final occupied entry, before un used capacity.
Sets the old final occupied slot to None.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: Executable checks saved under checks/ where applicable.
